title: Pyne Pod Sakura Grape Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pyne Pod NicSalts Sakura Grape 10ml E-Liquid provides a uniquely elegant and refined fruit experience. This flavour centres on the deep, succulent sweetness of ripe Grapes, creating a rich and jammy base. To introduce a floral complexity, the infusion of delicate Sakura Blossom notes balances the fruit, adding a fragrant and sophisticated dimension to the exhale. It is a highly nuanced blend that offers a more mature take on traditional grape flavours. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Pyne Pod Nic Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Pyne Pod Nic Salts collection translates the intense, highly popular flavours of their renowned prefilled pods into a versatile 10ml format. Offering a more cost-effective and flexible alternative, the range covers a wide variety of tastes. Beyond the floral elegance of Sakura Grape, vapers can explore other irresistible blends such as the zesty Cola Lime, the tropical Mango Passion Fruit, or the cooling Frozen Peach.
